title: How to Obtain an Official Income Certificate (Karnataka & Central)
issuingAuthority: Tahsildar / Revenue Department / Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu
requiredDocuments: Salary slip / Form 16 or Income Affidavit on Rs 20 stamp paper
Ration Card / Voter ID / Aadhaar Card proof of address
Self-declaration of family annual income from all sources

steps.title: Online Application via Seva Sindhu
steps.description: Log into sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in and select Revenue Department -> Income Certificate.

steps.title: Field Verification
steps.description: Village Accountant / Revenue Inspector conducts field inquiry regarding family occupation and land holdings.

steps.title: Issuance of Digitally Signed Certificate
steps.description: Download 21-digit RD Number certificate with Tahsildar digital signature.

validityPeriod: 5 Years in Karnataka (unless income slab changes significantly).
